title: Mistake: sort() sorts text by default
why_it_matters: Numbers come back in a confusing order unless you add a comparator.
explanation: Without an argument, sort converts items to strings, so 10 comes before 9. Pass a compare function: a - b sorts ascending. Also remember sort changes the original array, so copy first if you need the old order.
try_it: Sort a list of prices from highest to lowest.
